posts.mainText: Anthropic signed an MOU with the Australian government on April 1 to collaborate on AI safety research and the national AI plan. Key areas include safe model evaluation, responsible deployment, capability assessments, and misuse mitigation through joint projects.
posts.replyText: Bolsters cross-organization AI safety efforts via public-private international coordination, enabling shared standards, knowledge exchange, and policy development to address global risks.

posts.mainText: Fathom's March 31 poll reveals Americans prioritize trust and accountability in AI governance, favoring independent experts over tech firms or officials. Support divides on international AGI coordination versus U.S. leadership, with strong backing for workforce protections.
posts.replyText: Informs legitimacy discussions by showing public consensus on core principles like accountability, while revealing partisan splits on coordination scope, guiding balanced policy design.
